description: This file defines the LuceneApiController class, which provides API endpoints for executing Lucene search queries within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles authorization, query construction, and execution for content and document searches.

classes.name: LuceneApiController
classes.description: A controller providing API endpoints for Lucene search queries, handling authorization and query execution.

methods.name: Content
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve content search results based on LuceneQueryModel.

methods.name: ContentPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve content search results based on LuceneQueryModel.

methods.name: Documents
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve document search results based on LuceneQueryModel.

methods.name: DocumentsPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve document search results based on LuceneQueryModel.

methods.name: LuceneQueryApiAsync
methods.description: Executes a Lucene query asynchronously, returning search results.
